newsitem.title: UK: Beazer improved trading continues into Q3.
newsitem.headline: Beazer improved trading continues into Q3.

text.p: Beazer Group Plc, the UK housebuilder, said on Wednesday that the improved peformance seen in its half year results had continued into the third quarter.

Reservations remained "well ahead of the same period last year," said the group statement. In the first half results, Beazer saw total completions rise 22 percent, with Beazer Homes in particular up 37 percent. The average group selling price was up 18 percent to 73,000 stg per home.
The newly acquired Charles Chruch unit, providing more expensive homes, made 113 completions, with the partnership unit completing 266, down sharply from 569 last year.
But the group said "While the number of partnership completions has reduced we remain confident as to the long term potential of this market."

The bright outlook into the second half was clouded by some uncertainties, however. Beazer said with an election due on May 1, there was a worry that the political uncertainty may upset the housing market.

Beazer also remains concerned about the skills shortage in the UK. "Finally we are concerned that the number of our sales development sites remains some way below budget." This was due to the problems in government planning procedures.
